title: Metabolite Extraction from Plant-Agar Plates for LC-MS/MS Analysis
author: Paul E. Abraham
materials: Freeze-dry: Freeze-dry the agar plugs (e.g., Labconco, USA).

steps.title: Prepare Agar Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the growth media and pour into plates.

substeps.instruction: Mix agar (recommended 2%) or agarose (recommended 0.3%) with appropriate growth media.
Adjust pH as needed and autoclave to sterilize.
Pour media into sterile Petri dishes (typically 90 mm or 100 mm diameter) and allow to cool and solidify under sterile conditions.

steps.title: Transplant Plant onto Agar Plate
steps.instruction: Embed plant roots into the agar surface within a sterile laminar flow hood.

substeps.instruction: Using sterile forceps, lay the root system on the media surface and spread roots so one traverses the middle and others are pushed apart.
Gently push roots into the media using sterile forceps until fully embedded.
Place the plate on an inverted lid of a sterile plastic container, position an inverted container over the cutting to hold it upright, and seal by snapping it into place.
Label the container and place in a light room or plant incubation chamber.

steps.title: Excise and Store Root Tissue
steps.instruction: Collect root samples and preserve them.

substeps.instruction: Excise roots from each plant using a sterile scalpel.
Transfer root tissue into separate vials.
Freeze immediately in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Process Root Tissue for Extraction
steps.instruction: Dry and grind the root tissue into powder.

substeps.instruction: Freeze-dry the root tissue (e.g., Labconco, USA) and record the dry weights for each sample.
Grind the freeze-dried tissue in liquid nitrogen into a fine powder using a cryogrinder (e.g., SPEX Sample Prep 2010 GENO/GRINDER) or mortar and pestle.
Store powdered samples on ice.

steps.title: Collect Spatially Resolved Rhizodeposits
steps.instruction: Collect agar plugs from specific regions around the roots.

substeps.instruction: Use an inverted 1 mL pipette tip to cut and collect agar plugs of equal volume from distinct spatial regions (e.g., root base, root tips, and regions distant from the root base and tip).
Immediately freeze plugs in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Solvents
steps.instruction: Prepare the hydrated ethyl acetate solvent mixture.

substeps.instruction: Mix HPLC-grade ethyl acetate with HPLC grade water in a 1:1 ratio to create hydrated ethyl acetate solvent.
Transfer the hydrated ethyl acetate and HPLC grade water to separate containers and chill both on ice.

steps.title: Perform Metabolite Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract metabolites from both powdered root samples and agar plugs.

substeps.instruction: Add equal volumes of ice-cold, hydrated LC-MS grade ethyl acetate and LC-MS grade water (total volume = 2 mL) to each sample (powdered root or agar plug). Note: Total solvent volume can be adjusted based on sample amount.
Vortex samples at maximum speed for 1 minute to mix thoroughly while keeping samples on ice.
Transfer samples to a fridge set at 4°C and incubate on ice overnight.

steps.title: Separate Organic and Aqueous Fractions
steps.instruction: Isolate the two solvent phases from the extracts.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at maximum speed for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully separate the organic (ethyl acetate) and aqueous supernatant fractions using aspiration, keeping samples on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Organic Fraction for Analysis
steps.instruction: Process the ethyl acetate extract for LC-MS/MS.

substeps.instruction: Dry the ethyl acetate extracts completely in a chemical fume hood.
Resuspend each extract in 50 μL of organic solvent (70% acetonitrile with 0.1% formic acid).

steps.title: Prepare Aqueous Fraction for Analysis
steps.instruction: Process the aqueous extract for LC-MS/MS.

substeps.instruction: Pre-wet 10 kDa centrifugal filters (e.g., Sartorius VivaSpin).
Filter aqueous extracts by centrifuging at 4,500 x g at 4°C to remove residual media and particles.
Lyophilize the aqueous extracts (e.g., Labconco, USA).
Resuspend in 50 μL of aqueous solvent (98% LC-MS water, 2% acetonitrile with 0.1% formic acid).

steps.title: Store Final Extracts
steps.instruction: Store both organic and aqueous extractions at 4°C for short-term storage until LC-MS/MS analysis.
